summary: Review diagnostic-accuracy studies for target condition reference, spectrum, threshold selection, verification bias, prevalence context and uncertainty.

must_inspect.why: Diagnostic claims depend on the target condition reference and verification process.
false_positive_guards: Imperfect reference is not automatically fatal; quantify how it limits the claim.

must_inspect.why: Threshold selection and evaluation must be separated enough to avoid optimistic performance.
false_positive_guards: Exploratory threshold optimization is acceptable when claims and validation status are labeled accordingly.
Treat this pack as review configuration, not as evidence or an automatic severity increase.
